title: Search-to-decision reductions for formula minimization from near-optimal formula counts and reverse gate elimination

license.name: CC BY3.0
license.adaptation_notice: Faithful editable transcription of official CCC2020 CC BY3.0 article31,35-page version. One near-optimal-formula-count/reverse-gate-elimination search-to-decision theme: exact formal33, Cor34 and randomized41 with all supporting original Sections2--6 author proofs. Complete formula, basis, isomorphism, canonical, partial, MFSP and input N=2^n conventions10--16, decomposition17--21/Algorithm1, Select22/23 and full Lemma24 two-injection proof with every substitution/DropLeaf/AddLeaf definition and Claims25--32, complete Algorithm2/Claims35--40/correctness/recursive-count and runtime analysis, and complete Algorithm3/Claims42--52 including all sampling/candidate/partial-completion reasoning and four-part runtime/probability bounds retained. All20 original bibliography entries retained. Near-optimal count t is |CanonOpt^(n+1)Formulas(f)|, with formulas counted up to labelled-tree isomorphism. Formal33 bound O(t^2 N^6 log^2N) retained as actually printed, alongside author subroutine bounds. Cor34 applies to all but o(1) fraction of length-N truth-table instances; random41 analysis explicitly yields 99percent runtime bound, while Claim50 supplies correctness under s>=L(f)/2. Exponential randomized notation is O(2^(.67N)), not (2.67)^N. MFSP oracle query lengths N/2N, leaf-size DeMorgan basis and author stated B2/size-convention extension retained; no general polynomial-time search-to-decision solution claimed. Standard external Lozhkin/Lupanov and Pippenger statements retained without recursive prior proofs. All source proof reasoning retained, including author-stated omitted easy Claim28 justification; no added proofs. Canonical representatives displayed with an overbar and pseudocode reflowed into editable sequential/nested lists preserving every original operation; original Algorithm2 line10 is explicitly tagged. Original printed variable/index and wording inconsistencies retained without mathematical correction (comparison15 display, AddLeaf extraD in final injection, i_p/v_p, source equality/inequality and part4 runtime lines). Section7 bottom-up alternative is outside this selected top-down theme, not counted separately. No required figures. Root handles compilation/database/publication.

core_obligations: Preserve explicit truth-table N=2^n model, MFSP oracle/query lengths, basis/size conventions, and isomorphism-aware near-optimal count t.
Retain every reverse-gate-elimination injection/leaf operation and original supporting Claim proofs.
Retain full deterministic Algorithm2 and all loop-invariant/correctness/runtime proofs plus average-case recursive-count argument.
Retain full randomized Algorithm3 and all four-part probability/correctness/runtime proofs; preserve99percent and all-but-o(1) scopes without claiming general polynomial-time search-to-decision.
difficulty_reason: The author reverses gate elimination to bound test-passing functions by near-optimal canonical formulas, then constructs a prefix-consistent candidate list using only MFSP queries. A second algorithm balances random optimal-formula sampling, small candidate enumeration and partial-function completion using formula-size bounds. The injections, invariants and probability/runtime tradeoff are explicit nonroutine mechanisms.
